desktopBaseline.check: W02 player controls, movable mini-player, and Android PiP on live Kick HLS. Process-death is explicit Start watching containment, not silent resume.

candidate.provenance: API 30 development client loaded Metro JS from the W02 worktree and a native rebuild of streamfusion-native-contracts that compiles PiP foreground handling. Playback used real Kick HLS for slug absi, not a fixture playlist.

observations: Mobile typecheck, unit tests, and eslint --max-warnings=0 passed on the W02 tree before this landing.
Watch played live Kick HLS for absi on StreamFusion_Issue_142_API30.
Pause, Mute, Quality, Fullscreen, and Picture in Picture were present and acted on the same session.
System PiP entered with mode=pinned and live Kick video.
Tapping the still-pinned window showed only system Expand, Settings, and Close.
System Expand restored Watch with PiP returned copy. Restore runs on native picture-in-picture-exited, not AppState active.
am kill did not terminate the process. am force-stop cleared it.
Reopen showed Start watching for absi. Playback did not silently restart. This is containment, not in-place resume.
Mini-player Expand measured about 180x132 px at 440dpi, which meets 48dp.
Mini-player relocated through bottom-end, bottom-start, top-start, and top-end snaps.
